capabilities: Define note types with templates, save folders, and frontmatter fields
Create typed notes via palette commands, selection, or an inline trigger
Open fuzzy file pickers filtered by frontmatter, tags, path, or filename
Style wikilinks per type and show hover preview cards with fields
Mark relations between notes written to both notes' frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a frontmatter editor; types are defined in settings and applied to notes automatically by their frontmatter.
extras: Canvas features (note cards, relation edges) require the separate Canvas Plus plugin. The optional 'Fetch page title from URL' setting makes a network request and is off by default. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define custom note types that drive note creation, scope file searches, style links, or link notes with typed relations.

relations.evidence: live in the separate Canvas Plus plugin, which reads your note types and relations from this one

summary: Frontmatter-driven note type system that adds per-type creation commands, filtered file pickers, styled wikilinks, hover previews, and note relations.
